about.title: Hayward Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Six people died in traffic collisions in Hayward during 2025, according to the most recent final crash records for the city. Each of those numbers was somebody's parent, partner, or child. A wrongful death claim exists so the family left behind is not forced to carry the financial weight of a loss caused by someone else's carelessness, whether that happened on I-880, along Mission Boulevard, at a workplace, or in a medical setting. Under California law, the right to file belongs first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and to the children. If none survive, certain dependents and heirs may step in. The claim is civil and moves on its own track, apart from any criminal charges the Alameda County District Attorney may pursue. Families here generally have two years from the date of death to file, and less time when a public agency is involved. Our team handles wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning you pay no fee unless we recover for you.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California gives standing first to the surviving spouse or domestic partner and the children, then to certain dependents and heirs. We can sort out where your family stands before anything is filed.

items.title: The clock is real
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county, or state agency may be at fault. Early guidance protects that timeline.

items.title: Losses that are recognized in full
items.desc: California allows recovery for funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. We work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member was killed in a crash on I-880 in Hayward. Does the location change anything?
items.answer: It can. I-880 carries some of the highest collision volumes in the city, and crashes there may involve multiple drivers, commercial carriers, or questions about roadway maintenance handled by a public agency. If a government entity is potentially responsible, a claim must be presented on a much shorter deadline than the standard two years, so it is worth speaking with us soon.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges in Alameda County. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs separately from any criminal prosecution. The criminal case is about punishment by the state, while the civil claim is about your family's losses. Waiting for a verdict could push you past the filing deadline, so the two are usually handled in parallel.

items.question: Is there any cost to speak with your team?
items.answer: There is no charge to contact us. We take wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning attorney fees are only paid if there is a recovery. You can ask questions and learn where your family stands without committing to anything.
